description: Erection of a single storey rear and infill extension with internal alterations to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (B96323 - HH - 1100 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 1101 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 1200 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 1201 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 1300 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 3100 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 3101 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 3200 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 3201 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 3300 (Rev A); B96323 - HH - 3500 (Rev A); Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  06 September 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear infill and rear extension hereby approved.
